values.note: Orange County's fee for its campgrounds (Kelly Park and Moss Park), effective 2026-10-01: site rental $18 a night for county residents, $23 for non-residents, covering 6 people, 2 vehicles, power, water and one dump; additional person $2, additional vehicle $3 a night; primitive site $15. Cancelling less than three days ahead costs one night. The park's $5-per-vehicle admission fee is listed separately.

fees.source: https://www.ocfl.net/Portals/0/resource%20library/Open%20Government/FeeDirectory.pdf ('Site Rental, per night, (6 people, 1 dump, 2 vehicles, power and water) $18.00'; 'Site Rental (non County resident) 23.00'; 'A cancellation fee of one night will be charged for all camping cancellations received less than three days in advance') + https://www.ocfl.net/CultureParks/Parks.aspx?m=dtlvw&d=22 ('Effective August 11, 2026, the Park Admission Fee is $5 per vehicle'), read 2026-10-21

facilities.source: Orange County Fee Directory FY 2026-2027 (site rental includes '1 dump'; 'Non-registered sanitary dump fee 5.00'), read 2026-10-21

hookups.source: Orange County Fee Directory FY 2026-2027 ('Site Rental, per night, (6 people, 1 dump, 2 vehicles, power and water)'; amperage not stated), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Booked online through Orange County's OCPortal (WebTrac), which needs a customer account; call center 407-836-6799, Mon-Fri 8 am-8 pm. 'Camping reservations can be viewed up to 45 days out.' Full payment at booking.

booking.source: https://www.ocfl.net/CultureParks/Parks.aspx?m=dtlvw&d=22 ('To make a reservation and complete payment online, please visit www.OCPORTAL.net to set up your account (if you are a new customer) ... Camping reservations can be viewed up to 45 days out. If you need assistance, contact our PORTAL call center staff at 407-836-6799'), read 2026-10-21

note: Orange County park at Rock Springs (Apopka), around a free-flowing 68-degree spring; the campground is a hard-pack shell-rock loop. Firsthand report: sites 35-70 ft deep, Site #17 a pull-through double, RVs welcome. No pets in the park or campground (ADA service animals only); outside park hours the common areas and waterfront close and campers must stay in the campground. --Claude
summary: County park page + FY2026-27 fee directory: $18/night resident, $23 non-resident (+$5), power + water + one dump included; booked on OCPortal (account needed) up to 45 days out. Not stated on the county pages: site count, amperage, showers, season, max length. Note trimmed of the site count, hookups, dump, booking and RV Life line; added the no-pets rule and after-hours restriction.
flags: Login: OCPortal needs a customer account to book ('visit www.OCPORTAL.net to set up your account'). Passes the softened rule (AWH 2026-10-14 #3): the county publishes its camping prices (Fee Directory) and a phone (407-254-1902), and it is a county park.
No pets allowed anywhere in Kelly Park, campground included (only ADA service animals) - worth knowing for a family with a dog.
